_about: Auditorium geometry for the countdown party mini golf. Built 16 Nov 2026 from four screenshots of the team's cable-planning tool. Values marked 'measured' come straight from the tool; 'estimated' were scaled off the screenshots and could be off by about 1 m; 'guess' means the purpose of the feature is unconfirmed.

coordinate_system.origin: Top-left corner of the auditorium as drawn in the planning tool (compass direction unknown)
coordinate_system.x: Along the 54.7 m length, from the stage end (left) toward the booth (right). Same X axis as the planning tool.
coordinate_system.z: Along the 27.1 m depth, from the top wall down to the bottom wall. Same Z axis as the planning tool.
coordinate_system.y: Up. Ceiling height not measured yet.

zones.label: Stage (guess)
zones.note: Left end carries Rivale (Ayrton moving-head lights) and 'Blind' (probably blinder lights) labels, so likely the stage. Depth about 6 m is a screenshot estimate.

zones.label: Dark blocks along top wall, purpose unknown
Open floor, top half (Zone A)
zones.confidence: depth measured (11.62), length derived from 45.95 measurement
zones.note: Crossed by a horizontal cable run near z 2.6 and vertical drops every few metres.

zones.label: Runway: raised, part of the stage (confirmed by the team 18 Nov)
zones.size_approx: 25.2 x 2.4 including the striped connector at the stage end
zones.confidence: purpose confirmed by the team; end position derived from measurements; start, width and height estimated
zones.note: Team, 18 Nov: the strip is a raised runway connected to the stage 'in the shape of a cross'. Nobody can cross it on foot, so the two floor halves only join beyond the runway end (x 31.2 to the booth). Height not known. The striped section at x 6.0-7.5 is probably steps or the joint with the stage. What the 'cross' adds is not confirmed: either stage plus runway form the cross, or there is also a cross-arm along the runway. Its position and size are needed.

possible_extension.confidence: estimated (about 8.6 m scaled off the dotted outline in screenshot 04, about ±1 m); not confirmed to be built
possible_extension.note: If built, the runway end moves to about x 39.8 and the open floor between runway end and booth shrinks from about 20.7 m to about 12.1 m.

zones.label: Open floor, bottom half (Zone B)
zones.confidence: depth measured (11.58), length derived from 45.95 measurement
zones.note: Crossed by a horizontal cable run near z 24.5, the main cable trunk near z 26, and vertical drops every few metres.

zones.label: Boxed structure, probably the control booth (guess)
zones.confidence: near edge derived from measurements; size estimated

measurements.from: Left reference point at stage edge (x about 6.0)
Just below the dark blocks along the top wall

cable_runs_simplified.note: Thick bundle along the bottom wall
Many vertical runs every few metres connect the horizontal runs to lighting (LX) and devices (D). Not mapped individually; see screenshots.
